value.rationale: Exact non-Markov diagonal coarse-graining of a classical invertible hyperbolic baker system yields opposite-sign sharp \(n2^{-n}\) correlation tails for two natural diagonal half-square sensors. One sensor is independent at lag one but dependent at all later lags, exposing a genuine blind spot in low-lag binary dependence diagnostics. The geometric orientation-dependent correlation classification is naturally motivated rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
